Recent release of _climakitae_ 1.2.3 and reorganization of data access notebooks on the Cal-Adapt: Analytics Engine JupyterHub. Updates include performance improvements, bug fixes, a new renewable energy data notebook, and a stremlined structure for data access notebooks. If your notebooks don't update automatically, follow the steps in the release notes to refresh your copy. You can read the full release notes [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1f4Z9mXJyMqRJ9MQyCVWf15aKwcynRwLD/view?usp=drive_link).
